proposedCodeContributions.change: Proposed exports, not existing symbols: accept RequestContext, a server-resolved RepositoryBinding/policy and trusted authorization services; authorize workspace via assertCallerOwnsWorkspace before binding/policy content or provider access, then validate current actor/source ACL. Requests identify a binding/ref and repository-relative file, never an authoritative caller-chosen absolute root. Resolve binding.canonicalRoot and allowedRoots by realpath, compare node:path.relative containment with separator boundaries, reject absolute/traversal/foreign paths, and reject symlink targets outside the allowed repository. Apply mandatory exclusions plus policy exclusions, bounded byte size and binary checks before returning authorized content. Keep one internal resolver for reads/writes/jobs; return content/version provenance and safe skip/denial codes, not raw paths/secrets in denial errors. For mutation/job dispatch recheck scope and the opened file identity against canonical containment so a symlink swap cannot bypass an earlier check.
proposedCodeContributions.contractDependency: Exact RepositoryBinding/RepositorySnapshot/ProviderPolicy types and exports come from accepted CI-001, not locally duplicated interfaces. Trusted actor/source lookup is FG-IDENTITY.

proposedCodeContributions.change: Proposed exports: validate the CI-001 canonical ProviderPolicy schema; canonicalize server-owned allowedRoots, hash effective exclusions/policy, validate positive byte limits and declared retention/telemetry. Before remote dispatch require task-authorized per-job exposure metadata naming provider/version, authorized repository/source/snapshot scope, data categories, egress destination, retention and telemetry, with opaque credentialRef only. Local-only policy rejects remote provider/model egress before any dispatch. Verify signatures via the accepted authority, bind lease actor/workspace/source/repository scope and policy generation, enforce expiry/revocation, and invalidate on reconnect before reauthorization. Record last authoritative check, disconnection start and permitted-until exposure boundary; never claim immediate disconnected remote revocation detection. Mark repository-derived instruction content untrusted, with binding/source/version provenance; it cannot alter roots, ACL, credential authority or egress policy.
proposedCodeContributions.contractDependency: Lease, identity, credential and durable job/event readback services must be real accepted integrations; no mock production fallback or second policy/credential store.

nextExecutableAction: Lead accepts this preflight as inspection only. After committing wave0, accept CI-001 implementation by artifact and authoritative readback receipts, resolve the approved implementation base/delivery hashes and identity/lease/credential interfaces, and acquire the two shared-path leases. Recompare all source hashes and read changed seams. risks: Workspace equality is not authenticated actor/source authorization; using clientId or isAuthenticated to sign a lease would weaken the contract.
Published historical baseline and supplied preflight revision differ; unresolved manifest placeholders must not silently become launch authorization.
Concurrent wave0/CI-001 integration can make source hashes and proposed field names stale; CI-001 owns canonical types and the final source capability representation.
Lexical prefix checks and realpath-only check-then-read leave sibling-prefix and symlink-swap escapes; exercise actual file access boundaries.
Secret/build/binary exclusion and byte limits must precede output/artifact/log exposure; merely filtering displayed search results is insufficient.
Offline cache authorization can outlive source ACL, lease or reconnect unless every consumer reuses the same resolver and durable invalidation state.
Immediate remote revocation while disconnected is unobservable; record the actual exposure window rather than promising impossible immediate denial.
Per-job remote exposure must include provider/model paths, telemetry and credentials; provider installation/availability is not egress authorization.
An optional source TypeScript field without coordinated runtime schema/storage migration can be ignored or dropped; that integration remains lead-owned and unverified.
Full AC-5 and untrusted-instruction acceptance depend on actual downstream consumers outside this package's ownership. Unit tests or unused resolver exports cannot establish full feature completion.
